prompt: please use openssl to implement the AES algorithm in C++
response: To implement AES using OpenSSL in C++, you can use the EVP interface. Start by including the necessary headers and initializing the OpenSSL library. Use EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new() to create a context, and EVP_EncryptInit_ex() to set up the encryption with AES. Then, use EVP_EncryptUpdate() and EVP_EncryptFinal_ex() to perform the encryption. Don't forget to clean up resources with EVP_CIPHER_CTX_free().
